queries.sql:
SELECT samplename, originalsamplename, sitename, country, longitude, latitude,
locationnotes, samplecontext, sitedescription, vegdescription, sampletype,
samplemethod, agebp, typeof(agebp) AS agebp_storage_type,
ageuncertainty, typeof(ageuncertainty) AS ageuncertainty_storage_type,
notes, empd_version FROM metadata WHERE samplename IN (?,?,?) ORDER BY samplename

LEFT JOIN publications p ON p.publiid=m.publiid
